company.description:
Simple. Spending. Software.

Penny is a cloud-based procure-to-pay system. Penny helps you digitize and manage your full procurement cycle from request to approval. Manage RFQs to vendors, compare quotations, send POs and even payment. penny was designed to make things easy and consolidate all of your organization’s spending needs into one intelligent system

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based procurement platform that manages the purchasing lifecycle from purchase requests and sourcing through approvals, purchase orders, receiving, invoicing, budget control, and payments.

productsAndServices.description: A managed procurement service that provides operational and strategic support for sourcing, supplier engagement, procurement workflows, and spend-related activities.
productsAndServices.name: Procurement as a Service

productsAndServices.description: A Saudi-focused platform for calculating and monitoring local content performance across goods and services, labor, capacity building, and depreciation and amortization.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $6,483,200, or 50.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,254,591 to $39,540,876, a 4.27x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 38 (-24 over 90 days) and market heat at 54 (-2).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
